playstyle.identity: Camille is a precision diver who locks down a single target with her ultimate. Her true damage legs and hookshot make her an exceptional duelist and split-pusher.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive gives shield based on enemy damage type. Q first hit gives speed, second hit deals true damage. W heals from outer half. E hookshots to walls then dashes. R locks enemy in a zone. E-E to engage, Q-Q for true damage, R to isolate.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Camille spikes at level 6 with her isolation ultimate. Trinity Force and Divine Sunderer scale her. She's strong as a split-pusher and diver throughout.

weaknesses: E can miss or be interrupted

passive.name: Adaptive Defenses
passive.summary: Auto attacks on champions grant a shield based on their primary damage type.
passive.details: Basic attacks on enemy champions grant Camille a shield that absorbs damage. The shield type matches the enemy's primary damage type (physical or magic).

abilities.name: Precision Protocol
abilities.summary: Two-part auto reset; second hit deals true damage.
abilities.details: First cast: Camille's next auto deals bonus damage and grants movement speed. Second cast (after short delay): Next auto deals increased damage, converted to true damage.

abilities.name: Tactical Sweep
abilities.summary: Sweep in a cone; outer half slows and heals.
abilities.details: Camille sweeps her leg, dealing damage in a cone. Enemies hit by the outer half take bonus damage, are slowed, and heal Camille.

abilities.name: Hookshot
abilities.summary: Fire a hookshot to terrain, then dash to an enemy stunning them.
abilities.details: First cast: Camille fires a hookshot, pulling herself to terrain. Second cast: Dash to a target area, knocking up and stunning enemies hit.

abilities.name: The Hextech Ultimatum
abilities.summary: Leap to a target and lock them in a zone they can't escape.
abilities.details: Camille leaps to an enemy champion, creating a zone around them. The target cannot leave the zone by any means. Camille gains bonus damage against them. Zone ends if Camille leaves.
